summary: Market leaders by market cap: Samsung ($897B), SK Hynix ($498B), Micron ($481B). SK Hynix led HBM supply historically but Samsung re-qualified for NVIDIA/AMD HBM3E. DRAM prices up 60% in 2025, another 30-40% expected in 2026. HBM demand +70% YoY. Micron gained ~10pp HBM market share; still can only meet 50-67% of medium-term demand. Memory chips market growing from $86.5B (2025) to $92.7B (2026). HBM now 23% of DRAM wafer capacity.
